files.purpose: peak trend, filters, summary and record table
camera page with motion and zoom panel

limitations: Raster dimensions do not establish Qt logical pixels, client area, DPR, Windows scaling or exact fonts.
Only visible default and overlay states are evidenced; hidden hover, focus, disabled, loading and error states are not source facts.
The images do not prove permissions, NI device protocol, acquisition timing, camera ownership, algorithm validity, units or calibration.
Reference images remain evidence only and are not compiled as full-screen backgrounds.

screenInventory.summary: Shared shell with camera preview, FV curve, peak trend and three result metrics.
The main page remains in place while an acquisition-parameter drawer overlays its left side.
Equal 2 by 2 chart grid and a bottom summary strip.
Filter toolbar, peak trend, summary metrics and traceable PeakRecord table.
Large preview with capture actions plus device, image and media controls.
Camera page with a non-modal motion and zoom overlay.

primitives.rule: Persistent top status bar, left action rail, horizontal page tabs and a stacked content workspace.
Use Qt layouts with paired panels and consistent gaps; avoid screenshot coordinates for normal page content.
Parameter and motion controls overlay the current page without causing the underlying page layout to reflow.
Maintain an equal-width and equal-height 2 by 2 chart matrix; a smaller host may scroll rather than remove a chart.
Preview and capture controls occupy roughly two-thirds of the workspace; camera configuration occupies roughly one-third.

templateCandidate.note: Reversible desktop preview candidate preserving the reference aspect ratio; not a product requirement.

components.responsibility: Display brand, device/acquisition state, data mode, theme and settings; native window controls remain exclusively in the operating-system title bar.
Switch pages without stopping acquisition or clearing host data.
Render axes, labels, units, series, data status and host-supplied samples.
components.qtCandidate: Custom QWidget paintEvent or project chart component

components.responsibility: Collect the eleven visible acquisition parameters and emit save/reset intent only.
Present ordered PeakRecord rows with validity and run identity.
components.qtCandidate: QTableView with a shared PeakRecord model; template uses QTableWidget

components.responsibility: Present a host-supplied camera frame and independent camera state.
components.qtCandidate: Custom QWidget or existing video surface

components.responsibility: Emit display pan and zoom intent without implying physical camera movement.

typography.name: font.ui
typography.note: Implementation fallback only; the source font family is UNKNOWN.

desktop.rule: Use expanding layouts and preserve chart and preview readability within the desktop workspace.

minimumClientSize.note: Template candidate only; use scrolling for dense content below the target calibration size.

implementationGuidance: Keep the shared shell in one implementation and place business pages in a QStackedWidget or the host project's router.
Use real controls and layouts; never compile the six full screenshots as the working interface.
Keep NI, acquisition, calibration, algorithms, permissions, filesystem writes and camera ownership outside UI constructors.
Bind the debug peak history and peak-data page to one PeakRecord source; separate runId sequences and preserve invalid samples as null/gaps.
Do not display a concentration as valid until the host supplies a calibrated value and status.
Treat camera pan and zoom as display transforms unless a separate approved device contract states otherwise.
Validate keyboard focus, labels, contrast and reduced-motion behavior in the target application.

inconsistencies.description: Peak chart zoom behavior has conflicting descriptions in project notes: constrained interval/directional zoom versus unrestricted drag and wheel zoom.
inconsistencies.handling: Keep zoom actions visual-only in this template; confirm the interaction contract before product integration.

inconsistencies.description: The samples display connected device, live acquisition and calibrated-looking result values, but no device, algorithm or calibration contract was supplied.
inconsistencies.handling: The template deliberately renders unconnected, simulated and uncalibrated states.

confidenceSummary.EXACT: Reference file identity, pixel dimensions, file hashes and the visibly present pages, panels and labels.
confidenceSummary.INFERRED: Semantic component hierarchy, Qt control choices, shared shell, overlay behavior, spacing clusters and implementation constraints.
confidenceSummary.ESTIMATED: Colors, radii, proportions and candidate logical control sizes derived from raster evidence.
confidenceSummary.UNKNOWN: Exact font, DPR, client area, breakpoints, hidden interaction states, permissions, device and algorithm contracts, real units and calibration.
